newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish April core inflation up 0.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Finnish April core inflation up 0.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Finnish core inflation rose 0.4 percent year-on-year in April and 0.2 percent over March, Statistics Finland said in a statement on Monday.
The mean of six economists' forecasts for April core inflation was for a 0.5 percent rise (range 0.4-0.6 percent).
The Bank of Finland's target for the year-on-year change in the underlying rate of inflation -- its chief gauge for monetary policy -- is a rise of no more than around two percent.
